description: Produces SATISFIED, VIOLATED, and REJECTED naturally (never forced) on the three-node chain, by crossing attenuation_db_per_m (low: negligible photon loss; high: the same 0.025 dB/m calibration that produces a genuine throughput-driven VIOLATED in notebook 14 of Fase H2) with min_fidelity (0.6: within the swap-only ceiling ~0.6864; 0.95: above even the one-round-purified ceiling ~0.7203, so the planner rejects it before any simulation runs, regardless of attenuation). requested_pairs/duration_s are deliberately not swept here: validation.success_conditions are declared independently of requirements (by design, see notebook 13 of Fase H2), so a swept requested_pairs would not correspondingly change the fixed "delivered_pairs >= 10" condition - sweeping it would not test what this campaign needs it to test (see docs/campaign_architecture.md, limitations).
